sources.observed: Official identity, 8 Post Office Avenue, two storeys, front entrance requires temporary ramp, ground auditorium/bar and upper lounge.

sources.author: David Simpson
sources.observed: Western entrance elevation with paired first-floor windows, stepped brick porch/parapet, pediment, fanlight, cream stone bands, black panelled door and red signs. Private photograph retained outside source control.
Close photograph of gauged brick semicircular arch, keystone, cream triangular pediment and consoles.
Entrance at end of passage between 6 and 10 Post Office Avenue; metal gate, stone paving, no gap closure.
Eastern gable partly visible beside supermarket; blocked tall arched opening and cream impost/sill, external stair glimpse.
Roof is compound pitched slate, hipped western end and eastern gable; small southern lean-to, northern projecting roof step, rooftop stacks and vents.
